source.title: Final Test and Evaluation Results from the Solar Two Project
source.distribution: Approved for public release; further dissemination unlimited.
source.repository_policy: The report PDF is not copied into this repository. Only cited public test values and provenance are tracked.

supporting_sources.title: Solar Power Tower Design Basis Document
supporting_sources.use: Table 1-1 tabulates 60/40 nitrate-salt properties from 500 to 1100 degF; section 1.6.3 states analytic property formulas for 300 to 600 degC.

extracted_sections.interpretation_limit: The report accounts for inaccessible tank heels and sump inventory but does not publish a separate active salt mass; total inventory must not be used as active inventory to manufacture agreement. The executable model evaluates the 290 degC cold state with SAND2001-2100 Table 1-1, not by extrapolating CoolProp NaK below its declared 300 degC limit.

Salt outlet temperature, feedwater state, steam flow, and turbine exhaust state are not all tabulated here. These points support boundary-constrained and held-out performance studies, not a fully specified first-principles cycle prediction by themselves.

derived_audit.basis: SAND2001-2100 Table 1-1 enthalpy integration between 290 and 554 degC
derived_audit.interpretation: This does not disprove the report. It quantifies why the published total 1380-tonne inventory cannot be treated as active inventory: the report explicitly subtracts inaccessible tank heels and sump inventory but does not publish their separate mass. The 107 MWh value remains non-reproducible from public inputs alone.
